notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: He has played 31 minutes in each of his last three games while playing through a sprained right wrist, and the wrist has not slowed him (72 DraftKings points on Saturday). Houston is on the second night of a back-to-back after a 28-point win in Washington.
notes.Jayson Tatum: Boston pulled its starters after the third quarter of Sunday's 37-point win over Dallas, so Tatum played only 30 minutes before this second night of a back-to-back. Orlando is still without Paolo Banchero, and Boston had not posted its injury report Monday morning.
notes.Deni Avdija: Ja Morant (left hamstring strain) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) are out again, and Avdija has played 34 or 35 minutes in each of his last three games with them out.
notes.Alperen Sengun: He sat most of the fourth quarter of Sunday's 28-point win in Washington and played only 28 minutes after 37 in each of the two games before. This is the second night of a back-to-back, and Houston had not posted its injury report Monday morning, so Fred VanVleet's return after sitting Sunday is not confirmed.
notes.Cameron Boozer: Zach Edey (left ankle), Isaiah Stewart (illness) and Quinten Post (concussion protocol) are all questionable, which leaves Memphis thin up front if they sit. Boozer's minutes slipped to 25 and 29 in his last two games after 33 in each of the two before.
notes.Jerami Grant: He left Friday's game after a collision with Herbert Jones and sat Saturday, but he is not on Monday's injury report. Memphis went small with Grant at the big spot after Zach Edey went out, and Edey, Isaiah Stewart and Quinten Post are all questionable tonight.
notes.L.J. Cryer: Stephen Curry (oblique), Brandon Williams (hamstring) and Moses Moody are all out, and Cryer has played 18 and 24 minutes in the two games since Curry got hurt. About nine of the 24 came in garbage time of Friday's blowout at San Antonio.
notes.Charles Bassey: Kristaps Porzingis is away from the team, so Bassey has the backup center minutes; he has played 13 to 20 minutes in his last three games, and about nine of the 20 on Friday came in garbage time.
notes.Javon Small: Ty Jerome (right hip) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (lumbar disc herniation) are out again, and Small played 30 minutes on Saturday, the first game Jerome missed. Cam Spencer started in Jerome's place that night.
notes.Taylor Hendricks: He played 19 and 29 minutes in the two games Zach Edey missed. Edey (left ankle), Isaiah Stewart (illness) and Quinten Post (concussion protocol) are all questionable tonight, so his minutes depend on how many of them play.
notes.Jordan Poole: Trey Murphy III, Bennedict Mathurin, Bryce McGowens and Dejounte Murray are all out again, and Poole has played 21 to 24 minutes off the bench in each of his last three games as one of the few healthy New Orleans guards.
notes.Jaylen Wells: He has started Memphis's recent games at 25 to 31 minutes, and the guard group is thinner with Ty Jerome and Scotty Pippen Jr. both out.
notes.Thomas Bryant: He started Saturday only because Jarrett Allen and Evan Mobley were both out. Mobley (left great toe sprain) is out again, but Allen is not on Cleveland's injury report, so Bryant should go back to backup center.
notes.Jarrett Allen: Evan Mobley is out with a left great toe sprain and Allen is off the injury report after sitting Saturday, so he should start at center; he played 32 minutes in each of his last two games.
notes.Joel Embiid: He sat the first night of the back-to-back on Sunday, when Jabari Walker started and Dean Wade played 35 minutes off the bench. Philadelphia had not posted its injury report Monday morning, so his status is not posted.
notes.LeBron James: He played 33 minutes in Sunday's day game, and Monday at Brooklyn is the second night of the back-to-back. Philadelphia had not posted its injury report Monday morning, so his status is not posted.
notes.Dean Wade: He played 34 minutes as a starter when LeBron James sat on November 12 and 35 off the bench when Joel Embiid sat Sunday. Philadelphia's report for the second night of the back-to-back is not posted yet.
notes.Franz Wagner: Paolo Banchero is out again, and Wagner has played 36 to 39 minutes in each of his last three games as Orlando's lead creator.
notes.Brandin Podziemski: Stephen Curry has no timeline yet (Steve Kerr said they will know more in two weeks), so Podziemski stays in the starting backcourt with De'Anthony Melton.
notes.Jeremiah Fears: Dejounte Murray (left ankle sprain, trade request) and Trey Murphy III are out again, and Fears has played 33 and 34 minutes in the two games since both went out.
notes.Devin Booker: He sat the entire fourth quarter Sunday while the bench nearly erased a 31-point Lakers lead, so his 28 minutes were a coaching choice, not an injury.
